authority: the D1 archie-claim on the unblock_decisions row (BH-8817) is the record; these are per-card retry counters (BH-9446)
note: state/archie-cards-retry/<card id>.json {row_id, project, lever, reason, brief, attempts, last_detail}: bin/archie-cards.sh pull writes one when a lever answers failed, retry_pass reads and rewrites it (tmp+mv). Deleted on a terminal outcome (acted or needs-operator) or when the card leaves the open rows or is routed. At most ARCHIE_CARDS_LEVER_RETRY_MAX more ticks per card. Losing a file costs one the operator card sooner. Hub only, never carried

authority: the unblock tick's consecutive-tick counters for unread GitHub inputs (BH-9446)
note: state/unblock-unreadable/<project>-<owner>__<name>: one line `<ticks> <since_epoch> <project> <repo>`, bin/lib/unblock/unreadable.sh ubu_fold. Written tmp+mv before the decisions change; deleted on the first tick with no unread input for that repo. One file per project and repo, no growth. Losing a file costs at most UNBLOCK_UNREADABLE_CARD_AFTER_TICKS more ticks before the source card. Hub only, never carried
